description: Asks what InStr and StrComp return over the stored edge strings of Tx: InStr for 'a', 'b', Chr(0) and a space, in text and binary compare, from a start of 2, and InStr of the whole stored value inside itself; StrComp against 'a' and against 'A' in binary, text and database compare, and of each value against itself in the three modes. Each form is one snapshot ordered by ID over the rows with a non-Null T, followed by DBEngine.Errors. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
